output.title: ValidateCAA feature gate removal: no feature-gate settings visible
output.content: The change makes the deprecated `ValidateCAA` feature gate a no-op that only logs a warning. The environment summary lists 9 values keys, and none is a feature-gate key. However, values are marked "partial", and the summary does not show controller extraArgs or `--feature-gates` flags in the manifests. Check the HelmRelease, Argo CD Application and helmfile values, plus any Deployment args, for `ValidateCAA`. If it is set, remove it. The effect is only a warning log line.
